mechanism: Ibuprofen may increase praziquantel plasma concentrations through CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for hepatic metabolism, while NSAIDs can reduce praziquantel efficacy and increase GI adverse effects.
action: Monitor for praziquantel efficacy and toxicity; consider alternative analgesia such as acetaminophen; if concurrent use necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration.
